title: Tailored Resume Generation Output
description: Contract for POST /functions/v1/generate-tailored-resume. Grounded in resume_matcher.py outputs (ats_score, keywords_to_add, resume_editing_prompt). tailoring_notes explains what changed and feeds the FE 'what changed' summary. Never invent experience not present in the source resume.

tailored_resume_markdown.description: Full tailored resume in markdown, same facts as source resume, re-ordered and re-worded to match the JD.

keywords_added.description: JD keywords from resume_matcher.keywords_to_add that were woven in.

tailoring_notes.description: Human-readable bullets: what was emphasized/reordered, e.g. 'Emphasized React Native experience to match mobile requirement'.
